description: A shell script for testing 'git read-tree' functionality with sparse checkout features, including setup, various sparse-checkout patterns, and worktree consistency checks.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes a shell command sequence as the test.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Executes 'git read-tree' expecting it to succeed with specified options.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Executes 'git read-tree' expecting it to fail with specified options.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks if the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for content equality.

methods.name: test_diff
methods.description: Performs a diff check; used in the context for verifying no differences.
